dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Hey there, friend! Would you like to try my marvelous, revitalizing, energizing tonic? The recipe's a secret! It'll give you the strength to best ten opponents without breaking a sweat. I guarantee you'll be coming back for more!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Hehe, healthy miracle tonic of course! Now, my friend, you're clearly someone with a radiant glow, but what if I told you I could make you shine even brighter?

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: This isn't just any old fruit juice, it's the confluence of ancient medicinal wisdom with modern creative techniques. It's the real deal, that I can guarantee — a hundred and ten percent!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Only the finest ingredients and most skilled labor went into composing this concoction. In fact, I guarantee that after drinking my healthy tonic, you'll run faster than a weasel thief, jump higher than a forest boar, and train harder than you've ever trained before!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: So what do you say? Would you like to try a bottle?

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: That's quite alright. I'll be here come rain or shine, so you know where to find me if you change your mind!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Haha, well then, how does jumping higher than a Qucusaurus sound? Wait, Qucusaurs don't jump either, do they? How about a squirrel... Higher than a squirrel!

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Either way, it's the real deal, the real deal I say! Just try it yourself — there's nothing more convincing than lived experience!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: On closer inspection... isn't it just a nutritional supplement?

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Well, there are nutritional supplements and then there are "nutritional supplements." I, the respectable, respected Capulin, rely on my reputation to do business. If my supplement wasn't the best around, would I be able to stand here every day and praise it so?

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Just look at those loyal customers, each one a living, breathing endorsement! We don't cheat people around here! If you buy my tonic and aren't satisfied, why, I'll dismantle my stand tomorrow!
